company_info.industry_info: Enterprise AI company specializing in large language models and AI products for regulated industries (finance, healthcare, manufacturing, energy, and public sector). Builds foundation AI models and end-to-end products for enterprise customers.
company_info.recent_news: In July 2026, Cohere laid off 20 employees shortly after securing a $500 million Series C funding round at a $6.8 billion valuation (raised to potentially $7 billion post-round). Company reached approximately $240 million in revenue as of February 2026 and will serve more than 17,000 enterprises by mid-2026. Despite layoffs, company is actively hiring in customer operations, partnerships, revenue, sales, product design, and modeling. Recently launched North, an all-in-one secure AI workspace platform.
company_info.company_culture: Mixed signals on company culture based on employee reviews. Positive aspects include: competitive compensation/benefits (3.9/5 rating), friendly and collaborative atmosphere, flexible work options, great perks (lunch stipend, health/dental benefits, home office stipend, co-working budget). Negative aspects include: unclear direction and strategic vision, management challenges (2.8/5 rating on Blind), concerns about workplace politics and favoritism, some employees expressing desire to leave. Overall employee rating 3.6/5 on Blind.
company_info.any_related_information: Cohere is headquartered in Toronto with offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin, and Seoul. Remote-friendly work environment. Founded in 2019 by former Google Brain researchers (Aidan Gomez, Ivan Zhang, Nick Frosst). North (the platform this role focuses on) is a secure AI workspace that integrates LLMs, search, and automation for enterprise productivity. The Agents & Automations team specifically builds workflow builders, execution engines, integrations, debugging tools, observability systems, and feedback loops for customers to create and deploy AI agents and automations. Stack includes Python, TypeScript with React, Postgres, and Kubernetes.
